# Pakt - Offline Translator App for Travel

> Pakt is an offline translator app for travelers, built by Lingofonex. It supports translation in 100 languages and voice output in 50 languages after the required languages or models are downloaded.

Publisher: Lingofonex (https://www.lingofonex.com)
App brand: Pakt (alternate name: "Pakt by Lingofonex")
Primary use case: offline text and voice-oriented translation for travel
Languages supported: 100
Voice output: 50 languages
Privacy posture: Pakt translates locally on your phone for prepared offline languages. No cloud required for offline translation.

## Pakt Pages

- [Pakt - product hub](https://www.lingofonex.com/pakt/) - Pakt product hub: offline translator for travel by Lingofonex; supports translation in 100 languages and voice output in 50.
- [Offline Translator App](https://www.lingofonex.com/pakt/offline-translator-app/) - Pakt is an offline translator app for travel. Translate in 100 languages and hear voice output in 50 when WiFi, roaming, or signal fails.
- [Offline Translator for Travel](https://www.lingofonex.com/pakt/offline-translator-for-travel/) - Download Pakt before your trip and translate offline while traveling. Use it in taxis, hotels, restaurants, airports, and more.
- [Voice & Speech Translator](https://www.lingofonex.com/pakt/voice-speech-translator/) - Speak, translate, and hear voice output offline with Pakt. Built for travel conversations when internet access is unreliable.
- [Conversation Translator](https://www.lingofonex.com/pakt/conversation-translator/) - Speak or type, show or play the translation, and keep moving even when signal disappears.
- [Airplane Mode Translator](https://www.lingofonex.com/pakt/translation-airplane-mode/) - Translate from takeoff to arrivals while WiFi and mobile data stay off.
- [Private Translation App](https://www.lingofonex.com/pakt/private-translation-app/) - Translate downloaded languages locally on your phone when personal travel details matter.
- [Best Offline Translator App](https://www.lingofonex.com/pakt/best-offline-translator-app/) - Compare offline translator apps by offline use, voice output, privacy, travel readiness, language support, and account requirements.
- [Translator for Taxis, Hotels, and Restaurants](https://www.lingofonex.com/pakt/translator-for-taxis-hotels-restaurants/) - Real offline travel conversations for taxis, hotels, restaurants, pharmacies, airports, and train stations.
- [Offline Translator for Japan](https://www.lingofonex.com/pakt/offline-translator-for-japan/) - Prepare Japanese before a trip and use Pakt across trains, restaurants, hotels, taxis, pharmacies, and shops.
- [Offline Translator for Spain](https://www.lingofonex.com/pakt/offline-translator-for-spain/) - Download Spanish before travel and use Pakt for meals, stays, markets, taxis, and transport across Spain.
- [Offline Translator for France](https://www.lingofonex.com/pakt/offline-translator-for-france/) - Keep French ready offline for cafés, train stations, hotels, pharmacies, taxis, and shops.
- [Offline Translator for Italy](https://www.lingofonex.com/pakt/offline-translator-for-italy/) - Prepare Italian for restaurants, trains, hotels, taxis, shops, and markets across Italy.

## Localization

The eight-page core Pakt cluster is available in English, Spanish, German, French, Brazilian Portuguese, and Italian. The five new scenario and destination proof pages are currently English-only. Localized hubs:

- [Pakt en español](https://www.lingofonex.com/pakt/es/)
- [Pakt auf Deutsch](https://www.lingofonex.com/pakt/de/)
- [Pakt en français](https://www.lingofonex.com/pakt/fr/)
- [Pakt em português](https://www.lingofonex.com/pakt/pt/)
- [Pakt in italiano](https://www.lingofonex.com/pakt/it/)

Legacy Lingofonex site sections remain available in 23 languages.

## Claim Notes

- Pakt is an app/product by Lingofonex. Lingofonex is the publisher.
- Pakt works offline after required languages or models are downloaded.
- Pakt supports translation in 100 languages and voice output in 50 languages.
- Pakt is built for travel situations such as taxis, hotels, restaurants, airports, pharmacies, and train stations.
- Avoid assuming high-stakes medical, legal, or emergency reliability. Use clear, practical travel phrases and verify important details.
